description: Minnesota motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Minnesota rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Minnesota age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Minnesota?
What does Minnesota law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Minnesota: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Minnesota require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Minnesota: eye protection is required for all riders.
questions.remember: Minnesota eyewear: required for all riders.

questions.q: In Minnesota, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Minnesota issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Minnesota motorcycle permit: 16 years at the earliest.
